//: THE SAME SCREEN IN THE OTHER LANGUAGE THIS APP SPEAKS. The keys are exactly the ones in the record's catalogue, and that is not style: a key that is in one file and not in the other is a sentence that arrives half-written -- with a raw {hole} on screen -- and no other check sees it. The lab's name, its tagline and the module's title are deliberately not here: they are the institution's voice, they live in Textos.cs, and they are never translated.

guardado.migrada: Your new tests now come in through {donde}, on this same phone. What you see here stays and is still yours; what this copy stops doing is looking for updates.
guardado.hospedada: It is being saved on this phone. Your record is yours and it is here: Mymi gave this lab a folder on your phone, and your assistant can read it from there.

guardado.rechazo: The folder refused the write. What you see on screen is not saved in “{carpeta}”. It is usually the permission, which expires when you reopen.
guardado.enLaAppInstalada: It is being saved inside the app, so your record survives closing. But your assistant cannot read it: that needs a folder of yours, and this does not allow them.
guardado.enElNavegador: It is being saved in this browser, so your record survives closing. But your assistant cannot read it: that needs a folder of yours, and this browser does not allow them.
guardado.sinCarpeta: No folder: the record lives only in memory and is lost when you close.
